exposure: CFH to CFHR1 gene conversion events
outcome: Clinical and prognostic data of pregnancy-associated aHUS
cohort: 22 cases of pregnancy-associated aHUS from the Spanish aHUS Registry
finding: The postpartum period was the time with the highest risk to develop pregnancy-associated aHUS and the group shows an association of cesarean section with pregnancy-associated aHUS.
